paragraphs.source_en: “You ask when I intended to go and buy it. In fact, I meant to go out and buy it the very moment evening came. Unfortunately, however, every time I put my head out, the autumn sun was still blazing fiercely. Ah, the anguish I suffered then was quite beyond comparison with the impatience you gentlemen feel now. When I had eaten the last dried persimmon and saw that the sun still had not set, tears sprang involuntarily to my eyes. I felt as if someone were following me from behind. When I looked back, the grove of Tōreiji stood dark and dense, looming like a black shadow in the dimness.
